idea-plugin.name: Worktree Groups
idea-plugin.description:
Keeps the Recent Projects list tidy when you work with many git worktrees (for example with AI coding agents):
  • files each linked worktree into a collapsed "<repo> worktrees" group, keeping main repositories on top;
  • removes projects whose folder no longer exists, including the bare .idea folder the IDE leaves behind when a worktree was removed while its project was known.
Only the Recent Projects list is changed: no files on disk are created or deleted.
